# Small Corpus Fixture

This short corpus is designed for smoke testing only. It aims to be long enough to pass the minimum size checks while remaining easy to inspect. The voice is plain and explanatory, using a mix of short and medium sentences. It occasionally uses commas, but avoids excessive punctuation. The purpose is to provide consistent, neutral prose that a model can analyze without guessing too much about tone.

The fixture should stay stable over time. Avoid editing it unless the tests need to cover a new behavior. It is not meant to represent any real author. It is also not meant to be a high-quality sample for style transfer. It simply has enough length to generate a stylometric profile in a predictable way.
